experiments.scope: Selected target sha256-r31-prefix-v1. One matched chaining value (the published first block M0) and the published second-block words W0..W12 and W14; each organizer trial seed selects new E13 and E15 values, hence new W13 and W15.
experiments.hypothesis: Given a matched chaining value that satisfies the Table 6 conditions of steps 0-12, the Step 3 completion of section 5 of proof.md produces distinct ordinary collisions of the complete padded target on every trial, using a few hundred candidate E13 values.
